adjacency.rule: Direct adjacency first resolves exact roots and licensed lexical compounds; otherwise concatenated registered roots may form one complete uniquely typed tight local application.

whitespace.rule: Whitespace separates larger written phrase units. Typed prefix parsing determines application boundaries across those units.

parentheses.rule: Strong fallback grouping for ambiguous/debugging cases; ordinary prose should remain flat.

canonical_examples: Permitted You Sequence MoveYouHere MoveYouThere : Self.

binders.rune_label_rule: Label text must be spelled from registered rune names; no free Latin variable identifiers in canonical text.
binders.domain_rule: Infer type from binding frame for Create/typed iterators, otherwise an existing Cuspell value/Kind witness supplies the exact semantic type. Witnesses are grammatical and cost zero mana.

collections.rule: Collection punctuation is canonical only for genuine Collection values. And/Or and Sequence/Concurrent use their dedicated flat v0.8 surfaces rather than collection-backed control forms.

quotation.new_name_semantic_reading: Sign/Name reference only; no magical macro expansion

style.target: flat foreign-language prose, not visible AST notation

sentence_mood.rule: The final punctuation both terminates the sentence and marks its mood.

sequence_surface.explicit_end_required: only when later material follows before sentence end
sequence_surface.explicit_end_rule: Standalone approved punctuation colon terminates the current flat Sequence event list before later arguments.

concurrent_surface.explicit_end_required: only when later material follows before sentence end
concurrent_surface.explicit_end_rule: Standalone approved punctuation colon terminates the current flat Concurrent event list before later arguments.

optional_arguments.rule: The omission marker advances over exactly one current optional frame slot without binding a semantic value. Frame order determines which slot is omitted.

pipe_binding.rule: A maximal pipe-connected token group is parsed as one hard-bound expression for parser debugging and historical compatibility only.
